event: Determine the relative direction of a knocking door sound from the perspective of a robot standing by a specific armchair and facing a fireplace.

sounding_object.description: Arched, dark brown wooden entrance door. It is a standard house door size, approximately 2 meters tall and 0.8 meters wide. It has black metal hardware, including a door handle. A decorative wreath is visible on the outside when the door is opened. This is the main entrance door of the house.

reference_object.object_name: Light-gray armchair closer to the wall painting
reference_object.description: A light-gray upholstered armchair with a modern, somewhat boxy design. It has dark wooden legs. It is located to the right of a large arched window, and there is a small framed picture on the wall immediately to its right.

facing_object.description: A white recessed fireplace of traditional style. It has a wooden mantelpiece above the firebox opening. The recess for the firebox is dark. During the video, Easter-themed decorations (a garland of bunnies and carrots) are on the mantel. A large, round mirror with a decorative, dark brown frame composed of small, colorful square tiles is mounted on the wall above the mantelpiece.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the light-gray armchair closer to the wall painting and facing the white recessed fireplace, when the knocking door sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
